name: Sonnet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Sector-relative-value rotation: long the laggard cyclical/value/duration sectors just turning up (financials, regional banks, biotech, long bonds) while shorting the most overextended momentum trades (leveraged semis, gold miners) now breaking down, using hard stops for intraweek risk discipline.

positions.thesis: Financials sitting near their 52-week high ($57.48 vs $58.41 high) on continued buyback/dividend strength; increasing 15%->17% as the rotation trade keeps confirming with no contrary signal this week.
Regional banks trading near their 52-week high ($74.86 vs $78.35) with steady positive momentum; increasing 13%->15% as resilient lending/fee trends continue to play out.

Biotech rally broadened this week on Moderna's surge pulling the whole sector higher, with XBI now just below its 52-week high ($165.73 vs $169.68); restoring 15%->17% now that fresh data (not just prior-week fatigue) supports the size, keeping the -15% stop.
